checklist.title: Prevent node crash from malformed SSZ payloads
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: P2P peer via EDGE-RAW-INPUT is UNTRUSTED. SSZ-encoded data must be deserialized within error boundary. Trust model indicates malformed SSZ payloads must not cause node crash or unbounded memory allocation. Fork digest validation and SSZ deserialization are first lines of defense.
executable_checks: HIGH: Send truncated SSZ payload and verify graceful error handling without crash
HIGH: Send SSZ with invalid length prefix causing huge allocation attempt and verify memory limit enforcement
HIGH: Send SSZ with invalid offset pointers and verify deserialization exception is caught
MEDIUM: Verify peer scoring penalties applied for repeated malformed messages
MEDIUM: Test that deserialization errors do not corrupt node state
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-P2P-PEER-LC-GOSSIP: UNTRUSTED. Messages arrive over unauthenticated gossip. SSZ validation critical for availability.

checklist.title: Falsify: Malformed messages do not result in peer disconnection
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by sending malformed light client messages. Peer must receive negative score adjustment per AMB-DENEB-LC-P2P-02. Repeated malformed messages must result in disconnection.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Send single malformed message and verify peer score decreases
MEDIUM: Send repeated malformed messages and verify peer is eventually disconnected
MEDIUM: Verify peer reputation persists across reconnection attempts
LOW: Test that honest peers are not penalized for occasional network errors
checklist.notes: AMB-DENEB-LC-P2P-02: Peer scoring must protect against malicious actors flooding network with invalid messages.

checklist.title: Validate blob KZG commitments at consensus-execution boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Consensus layer via EDGE-BLOBS-TO-ENGINE (Engine API) is SEMI_TRUSTED per trust model. Each blob must have valid KZG commitment and proof verified before crossing boundary (ASSUM-EIP7928-02). Blobs with invalid proofs must not be forwarded.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit blob with invalid KZG proof and verify rejection at CL before Engine API call
CRITICAL: Submit blob with commitment not matching blob data and verify detection
CRITICAL: Verify KZG batch verification is used for efficiency without compromising security
HIGH: Test that KZG library errors are handled gracefully without node crash
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-CL-ENGINE-API: SEMI_TRUSTED with JWT but content validation required. ASSUM-EIP7928-02: KZG proofs are cryptographic foundation.

checklist.title: Prevent acceptance of invalid validator deposits
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Prospective validator via EDGE-USER-SUBMITS-DEPOSIT is UNTRUSTED. Deposit must include valid deposit data root, correct amount (>= MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT), and BLS signature matching supplied public key. Trust model indicates full validation required before deposit tree addition.
executable_checks: HIGH: Submit deposit with invalid BLS signature and verify rejection by deposit contract
HIGH: Submit deposit with amount < MIN_DEPOSIT_AMOUNT and verify rejection
HIGH: Submit deposit with incorrect deposit data root and verify CL rejects when processing
MEDIUM: Verify deposit with invalid withdrawal credentials format is rejected
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-VALIDATOR-DEPOSIT: UNTRUSTED. CL must validate all deposit data from Merkle tree before processing into beacon state.

checklist.title: Prevent acceptance of fraudulent deposit snapshots
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Beacon peer via EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS is UNTRUSTED. Deposit snapshot must be verified by recomputing Merkle root from provided finalized deposits and comparing against known finalized checkpoint root (ASSUM-EIP4881-02). Mismatched roots must result in rejection.
executable_checks: HIGH: Provide snapshot with incorrect deposit_root and verify rejection after Merkle root recalculation
HIGH: Provide snapshot with modified finalized deposit data and verify detection via root mismatch
HIGH: Test that snapshot verification queries weak subjectivity checkpoint for validation
MEDIUM: Verify node falls back to full deposit log replay if all peer snapshots fail validation
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-BEACON-PEER-SNAPSHOT: UNTRUSTED. ASSUM-EIP4881-02: At least one honest peer needed; fallback to full replay required.

checklist.title: Prevent invalid withdrawals from creating ETH out of thin air
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Consensus layer via EDGE-BEACON-SENDS-WITHDRAWAL is SEMI_TRUSTED. Withdrawal must have valid validator index existing in beacon state. Amount must not exceed validator's withdrawable balance (ASSUM-CANCUN-BLOCKS-01). Trust model indicates JWT authentication but content validation required.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit withdrawal with validator_index not in beacon state and verify EL rejection
CRITICAL: Submit withdrawal with amount exceeding validator's withdrawable balance and verify rejection
CRITICAL: Verify total ETH supply increases correctly match withdrawal amounts
HIGH: Test that withdrawal sequence ordering is enforced (by withdrawal index)
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-CL-WITHDRAWALS: SEMI_TRUSTED but EL must validate to prevent ETH creation attack. ASSUM-CANCUN-BLOCKS-01 critical.

checklist.title: Prevent acceptance of blocks with invalid headers
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Network peer via EDGE-START-VALIDATION is UNTRUSTED. Block header must contain valid parent_hash, timestamp > parent timestamp, and correctly computed base_fee_per_gas. Trust model requires full header validation before block processing.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Submit block with invalid parent_hash and verify rejection before state transition
CRITICAL: Submit block with timestamp <= parent timestamp and verify temporal validation failure
CRITICAL: Submit block with incorrect base_fee_per_gas calculation and verify rejection
HIGH: Verify all header fields are validated including ommers_hash, state_root, transactions_root
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-NETWORK-PEER-BLOCKS: UNTRUSTED. Full header validation required per trust boundary specification.

checklist.title: Falsify: blob_gas_used and excess_blob_gas are conflated
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by verifying blob_gas_used represents gas consumed by blob transactions in block, while excess_blob_gas is computed from parent's values (AMB-CANCUN-BLOCKS-01). These must not be conflated.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Verify block with blob transactions has blob_gas_used = sum of blob gas consumed
MEDIUM: Verify excess_blob_gas is computed from parent.excess_blob_gas + parent.blob_gas_used
MEDIUM: Test that both fields are validated independently during block header validation
LOW: Verify documentation clearly distinguishes these two fields
checklist.notes: AMB-CANCUN-BLOCKS-01: Fields serve different purposes and must be computed/validated separately to prevent pricing errors.

checklist.title: Ensure testnet reset mechanism handles attacker validator takeover
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY: Malicious validator operator via EDGE-ATTACKER-DEPOSITS is UNTRUSTED attacker. Even with large number of attacker-controlled validators, reset mechanism must recover network within defined period (AMB-EIP6916-03). Attacker must still meet minimum deposit and valid BLS credentials.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Simulate attacker depositing validators toward 66% majority and verify reset triggers before takeover
MEDIUM: Verify reset period < validator takeover timeline for configured genesis size
MEDIUM: Test that attacker validators go through normal activation queue without bypass
LOW: Verify reset mechanism can be manually triggered by testnet operators if needed
checklist.notes: Trust model EXT-ATTACKER-TESTNET: Explicit attacker model. AMB-EIP6916-03: Reset period must be shorter than takeover timeline.

checklist.title: Falsify: Odd-length hex strings are accepted without handling
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by submitting odd-length hex strings. Valid hexadecimal must be even-length string from [0-9a-fA-F], optionally prefixed with 0x (AMB-HEXADECIMAL-02). Odd-length must be rejected or zero-padded with documented behavior.
executable_checks: LOW: Submit odd-length hex string and verify deterministic handling (reject or left-pad with 0)
LOW: Verify behavior is documented and consistent across all hex parsing functions
LOW: Test edge case: single hex character (should be handled as 0x0X or rejected)
LOW: Verify zero-length hex string handling is explicit
checklist.notes: AMB-HEXADECIMAL-02: Definition of valid hex must be explicit. Odd-length handling must be deterministic to prevent consensus issues.

checklist.title: Verify: Protocol correctness does not depend on instantaneous gossip delivery
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by introducing gossip delays. Protocol must assume eventual delivery within propagation bound, not instantaneous delivery (ASSUM-DENEB-LC-P2P-01). Verify safety under delay.
executable_checks: LOW: Introduce network delay up to gossip propagation bound and verify protocol safety
LOW: Test that light client sync completes correctly even with delayed update delivery
LOW: Verify timeout parameters are set appropriately for worst-case propagation delay
LOW: Document gossip propagation bound assumption in protocol specification
checklist.notes: ASSUM-DENEB-LC-P2P-01: Eventual delivery assumed within bound. Instantaneous delivery not required for correctness.

checklist.title: Verify: BN256 curve provides at least 100-bit security
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify BN256 curve parameters provide at least 100-bit security against known attacks. Security relies on DLP hardness per ASSUM-EIP196-03. This is design validation, not runtime check.
executable_checks: LOW: Verify curve parameters match documented alt_bn128 specification exactly
LOW: Reference published security analysis confirming 100-bit security level
LOW: Document known attacks and their computational costs
LOW: Monitor cryptographic research for new attacks on BN256 curve
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP196-03: Chosen curve must provide adequate security. This is cryptographic design verification, not runtime test.

checklist.title: Falsify: Precompile address mapping can be altered at runtime
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting to modify precompile address mapping at runtime. Mapping must be derived from immutable protocol constant (AMB-MAPPING-01). No runtime mechanism may alter mapping.
executable_checks: HIGH: Verify precompile address constants are immutable (const/final) in implementation
HIGH: Test that no API exists to register or modify precompile addresses at runtime
HIGH: Verify fork-specific precompile sets are selected at compile/configuration time only
MEDIUM: Test that precompile dispatch is deterministic across node restarts
checklist.notes: AMB-MAPPING-01: Immutability critical for consensus. Runtime modification would enable address hijacking attacks.

checklist.title: Falsify: Memory expansion exceeds block gas limit
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting memory expansion whose quadratic gas cost exceeds block gas limit (AMB-CANCUN-MEM-03). Must trigger out-of-gas exception, not allow unbounded expansion.
executable_checks: HIGH: Attempt memory expansion with size requiring gas > block gas limit and verify out-of-gas exception
HIGH: Verify quadratic cost formula prevents practical memory size from exceeding reasonable limit
HIGH: Test that memory expansion gas check occurs before actual allocation
MEDIUM: Verify maximum practical memory size is bounded by gas economics (likely ~100MB)
checklist.notes: AMB-CANCUN-MEM-03: Quadratic gas cost must prevent unbounded memory. Critical DoS protection mechanism.

checklist.title: Verify: Beacon chain finalization eventually occurs under normal conditions
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify finalization mechanism eventually finalizes epochs under normal network conditions. Deposit tree relies on finalization liveness (ASSUM-EIP4881-04) to advance finalized checkpoint and enable pruning.
executable_checks: LOW: Monitor testnet and verify epochs finalize within expected timeframe (2 epochs)
LOW: Test that deposit tree pruning waits for finalization before removing nodes
LOW: Verify deposit tree handles prolonged non-finality period gracefully (no pruning, growing tree)
LOW: Document that deposit tree growth is bounded by finalization rate
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP4881-04: Finalization liveness required for deposit tree pruning. Non-finality causes tree growth but not safety failure.

checklist.title: Acknowledge: EL trusts CL for withdrawal validity
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify EL trusts that withdrawals from beacon chain are valid and finalized. EL must not independently re-validate withdrawal eligibility. This is explicit trust boundary per design.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Verify EL applies withdrawals as provided by CL without re-checking validator eligibility
MEDIUM: Document that withdrawal validation is CL responsibility, EL is execution layer
MEDIUM: Test that EL validates withdrawal field structure but not beacon chain logic
LOW: Verify JWT authentication is only authentication required for withdrawal acceptance
checklist.notes: Explicit design: EL trusts CL for withdrawal validity. CL-EL separation of concerns. JWT authentication gates the trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify: EIP-196 precompile returns 64-byte output
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After successful ECADD/ECMUL execution, verify precompile returns exactly 64 bytes (32 bytes x, 32 bytes y) in big-endian format conforming to spec.
executable_checks: LOW: Execute ECADD with valid inputs and verify output length is exactly 64 bytes
LOW: Verify output encoding is big-endian (x coordinate in first 32 bytes, y in second 32)
LOW: Test point at infinity returns (0, 0) encoding as specified
LOW: Verify output format is identical across all client implementations
checklist.notes: Output format consistency critical for cross-client consensus. Must match specification exactly.

checklist.title: Verify: Out-of-bounds memory reads return zero bytes
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: When buffer read extends beyond current memory size, verify all bytes beyond allocated region are padded with zeros (AMB-CANCUN-MEM-02). Must not return uninitialized memory.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Read from offset beyond allocated memory and verify returned bytes are all zeros
MEDIUM: Test partial read (some bytes in allocated, some beyond) and verify zero padding
MEDIUM: Verify no information leakage from uninitialized memory regions
LOW: Test MLOAD, MCOPY, and RETURNDATACOPY all handle out-of-bounds consistently
checklist.notes: AMB-CANCUN-MEM-02: Zero padding prevents information leakage. Critical for contract security.

checklist.title: Verify: Hex encoding produces lowercase 0x-prefixed strings
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After encoding bytes to hex, verify output format is lowercase hexadecimal with 0x prefix. Consistency in output format prevents parsing ambiguities.
executable_checks: LOW: Encode bytes and verify output uses lowercase a-f (not uppercase A-F)
LOW: Verify 0x prefix is present in all hex-encoded outputs
LOW: Test that leading zeros are preserved (0x00, not 0x0)
LOW: Verify consistency across all hex encoding functions
checklist.notes: Output format consistency aids parsing and prevents case-sensitivity bugs in downstream consumers.

checklist.title: Falsify: Memory buffer implementation allows overflows
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Test state transitions by attempting buffer overflow attacks. EVM memory must use safe buffer (bytearray) preventing overflows. Direct pointer arithmetic must not be used without bounds checking.
executable_checks: HIGH: Verify memory implementation uses bounds-checked array structure
HIGH: Test that out-of-bounds write attempts are caught and cause transaction revert
HIGH: Verify no use of unsafe pointer arithmetic in memory operations
MEDIUM: Test memory operations at boundary conditions (offset = 2^256-1)
checklist.notes: Buffer overflow would be catastrophic security failure. Safe buffer implementation is non-negotiable requirement.

checklist.title: Verify: Light client can fall back to checkpoint sync if all peers dishonest
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Protocol must assume at least one honest peer per ASSUM-DENEB-LC-P2P-02. If all peers potentially dishonest, light client must fall back to trusted checkpoint sync mechanism.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Test light client with all peers providing conflicting data and verify fallback to checkpoint sync
MEDIUM: Verify checkpoint sync uses weak subjectivity checkpoint from trusted source
MEDIUM: Test that light client does not accept invalid sync committee proofs even if all peers agree
LOW: Document honest peer assumption and checkpoint sync fallback procedure
checklist.notes: ASSUM-DENEB-LC-P2P-02: At least one honest peer assumed. Checkpoint sync is fallback for trust bootstrap.

checklist.title: Acknowledge: EIP-196 security depends on DLP hardness
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify EIP-196 pairing checks rely on DLP hardness per ASSUM-EIP196-04. If DLP broken for alt_bn128, pairing verification is compromised. This is cryptographic design assumption, not runtime check.
executable_checks: LOW: Document DLP hardness assumption in security model
LOW: Reference cryptographic literature on alt_bn128 DLP security
LOW: Monitor cryptographic research for DLP breakthroughs affecting BN256
LOW: Document that quantum computing advances may threaten DLP-based security
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP196-04: DLP hardness is foundation. Quantum computers would break this. Design-level risk documentation required.

checklist.title: Verify: Precompile dispatch executes correct implementation
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After address lookup in dispatch mapping, verify correct precompile implementation is executed. Mapping errors could cause wrong function execution.
executable_checks: HIGH: Call each precompile address and verify expected function executes (not different precompile)
HIGH: Verify address-to-function mapping matches canonical specification exactly
HIGH: Test that fork-specific precompiles are only available after fork activation
MEDIUM: Verify precompile addresses with no implementation return appropriate error
checklist.notes: Dispatch correctness critical for consensus. Wrong precompile execution would break contracts and cause chain split.

checklist.title: Verify: Memory implementation uses safe buffer preventing overflows
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Verify EVM memory uses bytearray or equivalent safe buffer (ASSUM-CANCUN-MEM-03). Direct pointer arithmetic must not be used without bounds checking.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Code review to verify memory implementation uses bounds-checked data structure
CRITICAL: Test that memory operations validate bounds before read/write
CRITICAL: Verify no unsafe type casts or pointer operations in memory module
HIGH: Test fuzzing with malicious offset values to detect any overflow vulnerabilities
checklist.notes: ASSUM-CANCUN-MEM-03: Safe buffer is non-negotiable. Buffer overflow would enable arbitrary code execution or state corruption.

checklist.title: Verify: Snapshot sync falls back to full replay on peer conflicts
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Snapshot sync assumes at least one honest peer per ASSUM-EIP4881-02. If all peers return conflicting snapshots, client must fall back to full deposit log replay from trusted EL endpoint.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Provide conflicting snapshots from all peers and verify fallback to full deposit replay
MEDIUM: Verify full replay uses trusted execution layer RPC endpoint
MEDIUM: Test that fallback is automatic and does not require manual intervention
LOW: Document honest peer assumption and fallback procedure
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP4881-02: Honest peer assumed for snapshot efficiency. Full replay is trust anchor when assumption violated.

checklist.title: Falsify: Deposit events are out-of-order or missing
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: EL must correctly index deposit contract events by block number and log index (ASSUM-EIP4881-03). Missing or out-of-order events must be detectable by comparing deposit count.
executable_checks: HIGH: Simulate missing deposit event and verify detection via deposit count mismatch
HIGH: Verify deposit events are processed in strict order (block number, then log index)
HIGH: Test that beacon state deposit count matches EL deposit contract event count
MEDIUM: Verify reorg handling correctly updates deposit event sequence
checklist.notes: ASSUM-EIP4881-03: EL must provide correctly ordered deposit events. Indexing errors break deposit tree integrity.

checklist.title: Verify: Withdrawals increase account balances correctly
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: After withdrawal processing, verify withdrawal address balance increases by exact withdrawal amount. Total ETH supply must increase correspondingly.
executable_checks: CRITICAL: Process withdrawal and verify recipient balance increases by withdrawal amount exactly
CRITICAL: Verify total ETH supply increases match sum of all withdrawals in block
CRITICAL: Test that withdrawals to contract addresses trigger contract code execution if present
HIGH: Verify withdrawal to zero address is rejected (per CANCUNBLK-PRECOND-002)
checklist.notes: Withdrawal correctness critical for validator exit process. Any error affects economic security of staking.

checklist.title: Verify: Testnet warns when validator set below security threshold
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: Notion of 'sufficiently large' validator set must be quantified (AMB-EIP6916-03). Testnet with < 4 * safety_decay validators must trigger warning.
executable_checks: LOW: Run testnet with small validator set and verify insufficient validator count warning
LOW: Verify warning threshold is documented and configurable
LOW: Test that warning does not prevent testnet operation, only alerts operators
LOW: Document minimum recommended validator count for testnet security
checklist.notes: AMB-EIP6916-03: Validator set size must be quantified for security assessment. Warning aids testnet operators.

checklist.title: Verify: MCOPY with overlapping ranges behaves like memmove
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: MCOPY with overlapping source and destination must behave as memmove (AMB-MEMORY-01): source copied to temp buffer first. Result must not corrupt due to overlap.
executable_checks: MEDIUM: Execute MCOPY with overlapping ranges (dest overlaps source) and verify correct result
MEDIUM: Test MCOPY with source and dest reversed (forward and backward overlap)
MEDIUM: Verify result matches memmove semantics, not memcpy (which would corrupt on overlap)
LOW: Test MCOPY with non-overlapping ranges as baseline
checklist.notes: AMB-MEMORY-01: memmove semantics required for overlap correctness. Contracts may rely on this behavior.

checklist.title: Verify: CL independently validates EL state root
checklist.detection_procedure: INTERNAL NODE: CL must trust EL to execute transactions correctly but must independently verify resulting state root. If verification fails, block must be rejected regardless of EE response per trust model.
executable_checks: HIGH: Simulate EL returning incorrect state root and verify CL detects mismatch and rejects block
HIGH: Verify CL computes expected state root independently using block data
HIGH: Test that state root mismatch triggers block invalidation and peer penalty
MEDIUM: Verify CL does not blindly accept any EL response without validation
checklist.notes: Trust model: CL must trust EL execution but independently verify state root. This is critical cross-layer validation.
